Joshua Slocum, Sailing Alone Around the World.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/joshua-slocum/sailing-alone-around-the-world

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Joshua Slocum, the author, died 1909.

First publication of the text used: 1900 (SE colophon: 'Sailing Alone Around the World was published in 1900 by Joshua Slocum.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1900, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1995.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1909 or earlier (the last to die, Joshua Slocum, in 1909), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Sailing Alone Around the World was published in 1900 by Joshua Slocum.
- Wikidata Q505923 (Joshua Slocum), P570 = 1909-11-14 and 1909-01-01; both dates fall in 1909
